title: bet.events
description: One leg of money on a sportsbook bet, on the casino events exchange (CASINO_EXCHANGE, default casino.events). The envelope's `playerId` must be a positive JSON integer (never quoted, never fractional) equal to `data.bet.playerId`; JSON Schema cannot express that equality, the consumer checks it and dead-letters a mismatch. Unknown fields anywhere are ignored.

playerId.description: The player the fact is about; equals `data.bet.playerId`.

id.description: The leg's id; the idempotency key is bet:<id>.

type.description: BET (a stake) and ROLLBACK are acted on; any other string (WIN, a value added later) is acknowledged without effect.

amount.description: Signed int64 nano units: the whole leg, real and lock money. The postback payout of a BET.

realAmount.description: Signed int64 nano units of the player's own (real) money in this leg. Lock and bonus money (`lockAmount`, `bonusAmount`) is never read. Only a positive amount counts.

reference.description: On a ROLLBACK, the leg it reverses (the whole leg may be sent; only these fields are read). Other types may carry one too; it is read only on a ROLLBACK.

type.description: The reversed leg's type. Only a rollback of a stake (PLACE for a spin, BET for a bet) reverses anything.

bet.description: The bet the leg belongs to.

currency.description: Currency code of the amounts; anything but PARTNER_CURRENCY is converted by Currency-Exchange-Service.

createdAt.description: Its UTC day is the day the leg's turnover counts on; a ROLLBACK is dated the same way.
